title: Crispy Roasted Broccoli
description: Broccoli roasted hot until charred and crisp at the edges, finished with lemon, garlic and a little Parmesan. Ready in 25 minutes.

image.alt: Crispy roasted broccoli florets on a sheet pan with lemon

ingredients.prep: cut into florets, stems peeled and sliced

steps.text: Put the baking sheet in the oven and heat to {temp 450F oven}. A preheated pan helps the broccoli brown.
Toss the broccoli with the oil and salt until every piece is coated. Dry broccoli roasts crisp, so pat it dry after washing.
Carefully spread the broccoli on the hot pan in a single layer and roast until browned and crisp at the edges, {time 15 min}.
Scatter the garlic over, toss and roast until the garlic is golden, {time 3-5 min}. Toss with the lemon juice, cheese and pepper flakes.

notes: Leave out the cheese for a vegan side.
